name: NextGen Youth Workforce Program (WorkSource Atlanta Regional)
org: Atlanta Regional Commission, Atlanta Regional Workforce Development Board
city: Cherokee, Clayton, Douglas, Fayette, Gwinnett, Henry and Rockdale counties, GA
what_you_do: This is year-round workforce training and education for youth. It serves seven metro Atlanta counties. A contracted provider runs it in each county.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 24 living in Cherokee, Clayton, Douglas, Fayette, Gwinnett, Henry or Rockdale County. In-school or out-of-school youth who face a barrier such as offender history, homelessness, foster care, parenting, disability or being a basic-skills-deficient or English learner diploma holder.
pay_detail: Cost and pay are not stated on the page. Ask the program before you count on either. The page does not mention wages, stipends or work experience pay.
deadline_text: Year-round. No application dates are posted.
how_to_apply: The page does not describe an application. Contact the provider for your county. Clayton: 770-997-4511 (640 Hwy 138 SW, Riverdale). Gwinnett: 404-913-0769 (3805 Crestwood Pkwy NW, Suite 300, Duluth). Cherokee: 770-345-5483. Henry: 404-913-0769. Douglas: 770-997-4511. Fayette: 770-910-7733. Rockdale: 770-991-7608.
notes: This is the only Gwinnett and Clayton county youth workforce program found. The City of Atlanta, Fulton, DeKalb and Cobb are not on this page's county list; see their own entries. Providers named on the page: Cherokee Youth Works and Hearts to Nourish Hope. Georgia requires a work permit only under 16, and this program starts at 16.
